description: Governor's Secretariat - Southern Province - Do Hereby Appoint B. P. A. S. Priyadarshani as the Special Commissioner for the Term of Office till 04.11.2024 of Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette primarily concerns a government personnel change - the appointment of Bentota Pathiranage Anusha Sujani Priyadarshani as Special Commissioner for Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha. While it mentions the term of office and general duties, it does not provide detailed portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas that would qualify it as a Hybrid (Type 3). The content names a specific individual with a basic title ("Special Commissioner") without elaborating on specific responsibilities, making it a People Gazette.
